text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: private-controlplane: onprem-agent-silence for customer=Acorn-Health — 3 missed heartbeats. Alert link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PDT12345 :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: Escalation level 1 — page sent to eng-oncall.
Maya R.: acked. I'm taking first look. pinging the onprem-runbook.
Aj Singh: I saw this. Any customer reports?
Tess (CS Lead): CS hasn't received a direct ticket yet. I'm opening support ticket #AC-9123 and will notify Acorn-Health that we're investigating.
Diego L.: Onprem agent last heartbeat ~ 2300123380 in our logs. Looks like the agent stopped sending metrics. No control plane errors yet.
Priya (SRE Lead): Quick triage checklist: 1) confirm agent process is up, 2) check network path between customer VPC and our controlplane, 3) check NAT gateway/route table changes.
Eng Platform: pulling recent control plane connection metrics for that tenant... grabbing flows and syslogs.
Maya R.: trying to reach the customer's bastion for out-of-band restart. If we can't, we can trigger a DNS failover to the fallback control plane for that tenant (low-risk, will cause a reconnect).
Aj Singh: Maya, if you can't reach bastion, post the bastion IP and I'll attempt an SSH. Also paste the runbook command for restarting the agent.
Maya R.: bastion IP 198.51.100.22. Runbook snippet:
```bash
ssh ubuntu@198.51.100.22 -- 'ssh redwood-admin@10.0.5.2 "sudo systemctl restart redwood-agent && sudo journalctl -u redwood-agent -n 200 --no-pager"'
```
Maya R.: attempting SSH now.
Maya R.: ssh timed out. Looks like the customer's edge is not responding.
Diego L.: I can try from our support relay in eu-west-1, maybe a different path.
Aj Singh: I'll start preparing the fallback plan. How long until auto-escalation on PD?
PagerDuty: Next escalation in 8 minutes.
Tess (CS Lead): Notifying customer that we're seeing agent disconnects and actively investigating. ETA for update: 10 minutes.
Diego L.: I can reach bastion via relay. Running agent status:```
redwood-agent.service - Redwood onprem agent
   Loaded: loaded (/etc/systemd/system/redwood-agent.service; enabled)
   Active: inactive (dead) since Wed 2023-10-04 01:23:45 UTC; 5m ago
--- Logs ---
Oct 04 01:20:11 agent systemd[1]: redwood-agent.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE
Oct 04 01:23:45 agent systemd[1]: redwood-agent.service: Unit entered failed state.```
Diego L.: Looks like the agent crashed on the host. No oomkiller entries on node, but the agent binary crashed on startup with an HTTP bind failure.
Aj Singh: Possible port conflict after local change. Can you restart the service and capture logs?
Diego L.: Restarting and tailing logs now:```bash
sudo systemctl start redwood-agent && sudo journalctl -u redwood-agent -f
```
Diego L.: agent started, logs show immediate reconnect attempts to control plane. Heartbeat restored at ~2300123602.
incident-bot: Heartbeat recovered for tenant Acorn-Health at 2300123602.
Maya R.: Confirmed in control plane UI — agent back online, sessions reconnecting.
PagerDuty: Alert resolved automatically (heartbeat restored).
Priya (SRE Lead): Good catch. Root cause hypothesis: agent crashed due to local port conflict after customer deployed an internal service that bound the same port.
Aj Singh: Mitigation: document the port conflict in the runbook and add a preflight check (verify agent port free) to the agent service unit to avoid silent crash.
Tess (CS Lead): I'll follow up with Acorn-Health to get their deploy timeline and recommend a fixed bind port range. Creating follow-up support case and linking to incident.
Maya R.: Handoff — I need to leave shift in 20m. Aj, please take post-incident follow-ups.
Aj Singh: Taking it. I'll open a postmortem draft with timeline and actions.
Priya (SRE Lead): Action items:
- Diego: add extra logging to agent for port bind failures (owner: Diego).
- Eng Platform: add a synthetic monitor that detects consecutive missed heartbeats per-tenant and auto-annotates likely local crash vs network (owner: Eng Platform).
- Runbook: add preflight bind-port check and contact template for CS (owner: Maya).
- CS: follow up with Acorn-Health and update support ticket (owner: Tess).
All: please add work items to the oncall board.
Maya R.: thanks team. closing my side of the page. :thumbsup:
Aj Singh: I'll keep an eye until follow-ups are scheduled.
Tess (CS Lead): Notifying customer now — will update ticket #AC-9123 when done.
incident-bot: Thread closed automatically after resolution.
